xbi-spy-break.label: Biotech vs. the market
xbi-spy-break.meaning: Is biotech leading the market? The XBI/SPY ratio (equal-weight biotech against the S&P 500) is compared with its own ten-week average. A weekly close below that average says no: the basket is no longer clearly rising, so no new biotech entries. The alert clears after two consecutive weekly closes above.
xbi-spy-break.action: Check the affected holdings against their plan: no sale on this signal alone, the exits are the plans' exits.
xbi-spy-break.exposure_note: All biotech holdings: therapeutics, drug discovery, synthetic biology.

xbi-xlv-break.label: Biotech vs. healthcare
xbi-xlv-break.meaning: Within healthcare, is money taking risk? The XBI/XLV ratio is compared with its ten-week average. A weekly close below says healthcare money is leaving biotech for large defensive names: no new clinical setups. The alert clears after two consecutive weekly closes above.
xbi-xlv-break.action: Check the affected holdings against their plan: no sale on this signal alone, the exits are the plans' exits.
xbi-xlv-break.exposure_note: Clinical biotech and drug discovery holdings. Broad healthcare (XLV) is not counted: the rotation favours it.

sbio-xbi-break.label: Clinical risk
sbio-xbi-break.meaning: Is the market paying for clinical risk? The SBIO/XBI ratio (phase 2-3 biotech against broad biotech) is compared with its ten-week average. A weekly close below says trial risk is no longer rewarded: no new clinical setups. The alert clears after two consecutive weekly closes above.
sbio-xbi-break.action: Check the affected holdings against their plan: no sale on this signal alone, the exits are the plans' exits.
sbio-xbi-break.exposure_note: Clinical biotech and drug discovery holdings, the ones carrying trial risk.

vix-regime-peur.label: Fear on the S&P 500 (VIX)
vix-regime-peur.meaning: The VIX prices protection against an S&P 500 decline over 30 days. The S&P 500 is carried by its mega caps: a calm VIX says nothing about biotech or small caps. Above 28, even large caps are afraid, as in the 5% most stressed weeks.
vix-regime-peur.action: Check the affected holdings against their plan: no sale on this signal alone, the exits are the plans' exits.
vix-regime-peur.exposure_note: A volatility shock hits the whole book: no holding is singled out.

vix-terme-backwardation.label: Immediate panic on the S&P 500 (VIX ÷ 3-month VIX)
vix-terme-backwardation.meaning: Compares 30-day fear with 3-month fear: the SHAPE of fear, not its level. Normally distant fear is higher and the ratio stays below 1. Above 1, immediate panic exceeds future worry: an acute shock, which often comes before the level and fades fast.
vix-terme-backwardation.action: Check the affected holdings against their plan: no sale on this signal alone, the exits are the plans' exits.
vix-terme-backwardation.exposure_note: A volatility shock hits the whole book: no holding is singled out.

tnx-plafond-regime.meaning: The US 10-year yield had not closed a week above 5% in 15 years. Above it, money stays expensive: a headwind for biotech, healthcare and real estate.
tnx-plafond-regime.action: Check the affected holdings against their plan: no sale on this signal alone, the exits are the plans' exits.
tnx-plafond-regime.exposure_note: Rate-sensitive holdings: clinical biotech, tools and diagnostics, healthcare ETFs and listed real estate.

tnx-plancher-detente.label: 10-year yield — easing
tnx-plancher-detente.meaning: Below 4%, rates ease decisively: a tailwind for biotech, healthcare and real estate.

hygh-plancher-credit.label: High-yield credit
hygh-plancher-credit.meaning: HYGH is a high-yield bond fund (the most indebted companies), hedged against rate risk: its price follows the credit spread, the premium those companies pay over the government, and hardly the 10-year yield. When it falls, lenders demand more to finance fragile borrowers. Below 84.6 on a weekly close, it breaks the floor held since 2024: credit is repricing risk, often before equities. For clinical biotech, the financing window is closing: equity raises become costlier, or impossible.
hygh-plancher-credit.action: Check the affected holdings against their plan: no sale on this signal alone, the exits are the plans' exits.
hygh-plancher-credit.exposure_note: A credit shock hits the whole book: no holding is singled out.

queue-largeur-petites-cuivre.label: Market crash risk (breadth, small caps, copper)
queue-largeur-petites-cuivre.meaning: Three questions at once, each against its ten-week average: does the equal-weight S&P follow the S&P (RSP/SPY)? do small caps follow (IWM/SPY)? does copper lead gold (CPER/GLD)? When all three say no, the rally rests on a few giants and on fear. Measured over 2012-2026: all three together 35% of the time, and SPY fell at least 5% within the next 13 weeks 16.5% of the time, against 6.8% otherwise. The median barely moves: it is a crash risk, not a direction. The combination was chosen after seeing the numbers: it is judged on what it announces from 2026-11-03 on.
queue-largeur-petites-cuivre.action: Check the affected holdings against their plan: no sale on this signal alone, the exits are the plans' exits.
queue-largeur-petites-cuivre.exposure_note: A market crash hits the whole book: no holding is singled out.
